description: This file defines the DetailedLeave class, representing detailed leave request information in the OrangeHRM Leave module, including methods for managing leave data, status, workflows, and related details.

classes.name: DetailedLeave
classes.description: A class encapsulating detailed information and logic for leave requests, including status, workflow actions, leave periods, balance calculations, and approval process management.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the current Leave object associated with this detailed leave.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Sets the Leave object and resets cached details within the class.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets multiple Leave objects, typically representing multiple leave entries or periods.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves the iterable collection of leaves associated with this detailed leave.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Constructs and returns a detailed object containing leave date details, including duration and times.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the current leave status encapsulated with length days information.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current leave balance for the employee and leave type.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Determines and returns the leave period based on leave entries and entitlement strategy.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed actions (e.g., approve/reject) for the leave request.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches workflows permitted for the current leave status and user context.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a particular action (approve, reject, cancel) is permitted for this leave.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow configuration associated with a specific action.
